title: Indian Style Roasted Duck Leg with Irish Roast Potatoes
description: A flavorful and aromatic duck leg dish with roasted Irish potatoes, perfect for a special occasion. The tender meat and crispy skin are complemented by the earthy flavors of the potatoes.

ingredients.name: Irish roast potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and chopped into large chunks

ingredients.name: Roasted vegetables
ingredients.amount: 1 large onion, 2 cloves of garlic, 2 large carrots

instructions: Season the duck leg with salt, pepper, and Indian spice blend.
Heat ghee or vegetable oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the duck leg until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the duck leg for 20-25 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Meanwhile, toss the chopped potatoes with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, and carrots to the skillet with the duck leg and continue to roast for another 10-12 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the duck leg with the roasted potatoes and vegetables, spooning some of the pan juices over the top.
